Red Sea Shipping Crisis Impacts Global Energy Markets

The Red Sea shipping crisis has intensified, with Saudi Arabia and Egypt demanding free navigation through the vital waterway. Houthi fighters, reportedly backed by Tehran, have gained control over a key strait, disrupting shipping and energy markets. This disruption has led to the closure of a key oil pipeline in Saudi Arabia for weeks. The escalating conflict has prompted international engagement, with Australia's energy minister planning a visit to Saudi Arabia.
